text:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout slice 5/9 for v2 -> v1 traffic split on api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7077771234). watchers: @rachel @sam. 25m watch.
rachel: grabbing ops. quick note: client metrics flagged some older JS SDKs sending no X-Api-Version header; those clients will observe v1 behavior during staged routing. I'll pre-pin high-risk tenants.
sam: ran a small EU smoke last hour 1: saw transient 429 bursts from tenants with streaming enabled. not enough to roll back but enough to pre-pin. recommending pre-pin for tenants with streaming=true and mobile_ratio > 0.4.
ike: can deploybot apply pins with auto-expiry? want to avoid long-lived manual cleanup.
deploy-bot: yes, use `deploybot pin-tenant --id <tenant> --route v1 --expires 2026-04-07T08:00:00Z`.
rachel: applying three candidate pins now: t-101, t-204, t-305. tagging reason="streaming mobile 429".
deploy-bot: pins applied: t-101 -> v1 (rb-7077771234-pin1), t-204 -> v1 (rb-7077771234-pin2), t-305 -> v1 (rb-7077771234-pin3).
sam: re-running smoke: EU p50 latency +12ms, no 429 spike in 12m. good to continue to next slice.
nina: adding rollback/auto-fallback criteria to thread: if v2_error_rate >= 4% sustained for 5m OR v2_429_ratio > 0.05 for 3m -> trigger fallback. latency fail: p95 > 850ms for 4m -> fallback. Will update runbook entry: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-staged-rollout.
rachel: posting short release-note blurb to docs: "During staged v2 rollout, clients without X-Api-Version may be routed to v1; include explicit header to ensure v2. See SDK upgrade notes." link: https://go.redwood/release-notes/v2-staged.
sam: capturing traffic snapshots for potential postmortem. also adding temporary Grafana panel for v2 429 by tenant slice.
rachel: leaving this thread as the single source of truth for pre-pin + expiry decisions. will unpin after expiry unless flag set to extend. :white_check_mark:
nina: acknowledged. paging rules set to infra oncall if auto-fallback triggered.
deploy-bot: watch window active. will post final status at end of slice or on action.
